annotation.title_clean: К синтезу человеческой мудрости и вычислительной мощности. Рецензия на книгу Ф. Паскуале «Новые законы робототехники. Апология человеческих знаний в эпоху искусственного интеллекта»
annotation.title_en: Toward a Synthesis of Computational Power and Human Wisdom. Review of a Book by Frank Pasquale «New Laws of Robotics: Defending Human Expertise in the Age of AI»
annotation.venue: Управление наукой: теория и практика (Science Management: Theory and Practice)
annotation.summary_en: Review of Frank Pasquale's book New Laws of Robotics (Russian edition). It outlines Pasquale's four additional laws of robotics and his argument that AI should complement human expertise, shaped by legal and cultural constraints rather than displacing labour. The reviewer applies this to developing economies such as Russia and China, which lack adequate AI regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Pasquale proposes four new laws: AI/robots should complement not replace humans; not counterfeit human traits; not fuel zero-sum arms races; and always indicate their creator, owner or controller.
Automation should be steered by legal and cultural constraints, not only technology or economics.
Innovation regulation should involve the state and civil-society experts.
Developing countries such as Russia and China lack adequate legal mechanisms and debate on AI.
Synthesis of human expertise with machine computation is the preferred scenario.
